time_definitions.fit_wall_seconds: Trainer timer starts after imports, target/cache loading, normalization and GPU-cache transfer; includes epochs, stop evaluation, final checkpoint/prediction serialization and repeated cached-readout timing; excludes final receipt checksum/write and process cleanup. It is elapsed time, not GPU busy time.
time_definitions.queue_wall_seconds: Queue process elapsed time; includes child startup, data/cache loading, fit, checksum and teardown. Sum across concurrent queues is not stage end-to-end elapsed time.
time_definitions.head_queue_span_seconds: Last queue end minus first queue start, including inter-queue analysis/selection gaps; not an isolated compute benchmark.
time_definitions.cached_readout_sequences_per_second: Single repeated prediction pass on existing cached features; vector summaries or full residue cache already resident as recorded. Includes readout batching/normalization as implemented and device-to-host prediction output, excludes encoder inference, cache building/loading and general sequence-to-p deployment I/O. Very short timings are microbenchmarks.
time_definitions.encoder_seconds: Reported launch-to-receipt sum includes startup and artifact hashing for both workers and pilot; it is not profiled GPU busy time.
time_definitions.residue_presentations: Input sequence lengths summed over training presentations for every mode; vector modes do not perform residue-wise neural readout work, so equal counts do not imply equal FLOPs.

budget_observation.head_queue_sum_interpretation: Conservative allocated-time proxy from one queue per assigned GPU; includes process overhead, not measured GPU busy time.
